title: craftos-mcp project
description: craftos.json: a project's settings for craftos-mcp (the CLI, the MCP server and the VS Code extension). A flag or an environment variable still wins over it. craftos-mcp init writes one; schemas/craftos.schema.json is generated from packages/runner/src/project.ts.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors.

workspace.description: The folder with the Lua programs, relative to craftos.json: every computer gets a copy of it. Default: the folder craftos.json is in. --dir and CRAFTOS_WORKSPACE win over it.

minecraft.description: The Minecraft version computers run as; it picks the CC:Tweaked version and the mods' versions. --mc, CRAFTOS_VERSION and a world's version win over it.

addons.description: The mods besides CC:Tweaked: "all", "none", ids by commas, or a list of ids. --addons, CRAFTOS_ADDONS and a world's addons win over it.

tests.description: The test files to run when none are named: globs relative to the workspace (** any folders, * any name, {a,b} either).

world.description: The world computers start in: a .json file relative to craftos.json, or the name of a saved world in worlds/. --world, worldFile and world win over it.

run.description: The program the desktop app's Run button starts, relative to the workspace. Leave it out and the computer opens at its shell.
